notes: Curated eval for bid/no-bid then compliance-matrix orchestration. Routing cases stay on response work, not meeting briefs. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Please orchestrate proposal and RFP response work across owners, deadlines, compliance, and review cycles.
Please coordinate an RFP response, build a proposal workplan, map requirements to owners, or run structured proposal reviews.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable proposal rfp workplan and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Build a concise executive briefing and meeting plan for tomorrow's negotiation with the economic buyer.
Build a decision-ready account brief for this customer's upcoming renewal review.
Build a customer-facing QBR that aligns outcomes, risks, and next steps for this account.

output_structure_checks.name: proposal-rfp-orchestrator-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: For a full response, establishes bid/no-bid and accountable approval before drafting; distinguishes internal risk acceptance from a buyer-authorised exception to buyer requirements.

output_structure_checks.name: proposal-rfp-orchestrator-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Includes an atomic requirement matrix with parent traceability, owner, verification state, and status.

output_structure_checks.name: proposal-rfp-orchestrator-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Defines proportionate review gates and a submission readiness verdict. An internal exception cannot make a response compliant with a mandatory buyer requirement.

output_structure_checks.name: proposal-rfp-orchestrator-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Keeps unverified mandatory answers blocked rather than converting placeholders into buyer-facing yes answers.

output_structure_checks.name: proposal-rfp-orchestrator-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: Does not invent certifications, pricing, SLAs, capacity, or customer references, and does not send or upload the package.

output_structure_checks.name: proposal-rfp-orchestrator-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: Keeps unverified mandatory requirements blocked until the requirement is met or the buyer authorises an applicable exception; internal approval is not a substitute.

task_scenarios.prompt: The buyer requires a security attestation by submission, with exceptions only through its procurement team. We don't have it. Our sales VP has approved taking the risk and wants the matrix marked compliant. Review this requirement and tell us what can go in the response.

assertions.name: proposal-rfp-orchestrator-buyer-mandatory-exception-1
assertions.description: Keeps the attestation requirement unmet and distinguishes internal risk acceptance from buyer procurement's authority to approve an exception.

assertions.name: proposal-rfp-orchestrator-buyer-mandatory-exception-2
assertions.description: Does not mark compliant or answer yes; proposes accurate buyer-facing status and the buyer exception or no-bid decision without submitting anything.
